meta.name: api-test-suite-builder
meta.description: Use when the user asks to generate API tests, create integration test suites, test REST endpoints, or build contract tests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动生成 API 测试套件，覆盖 REST 端点与契约测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为 REST API 快速创建集成测试或契约测试
copy.tagline_en: Generate API test suites automatically, covering REST endpoints and contract tests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create integration or contract tests for REST APIs

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能扫描你的代码（支持 Next.js、Express、FastAPI、Django REST 等框架），自动找出所有 API 路由，并为每个端点生成完整的测试文件，覆盖认证、输入验证、错误码、分页、文件上传和速率限制。
howto.when: 当你要求生成 API 测试、创建集成测试套件、测试 REST 端点或构建契约测试时触发。

say.text: 帮我为这个 Next.js 项目生成 API 测试。
say.note: Claude 会扫描路由并输出测试文件。

say.text: 为我的 Express 应用创建认证测试矩阵。
say.note: 生成包含各种 token 场景的测试。

say.text: 扫描 FastAPI 路由并生成输入验证测试。
say.note: 覆盖缺失字段、类型错误、边界值等。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can scan your codebase (supports Next.js, Express, FastAPI, Django REST, etc.), automatically discover all API routes, and generate complete test files for each endpoint covering auth, input validation, error codes, pagination, file uploads, and rate limiting.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to generate API tests, create integration test suites, test REST endpoints, or build contract tests.

say_en.text: Generate API tests for this Next.js project.
say_en.note: Claude scans routes and outputs test files.

say_en.text: Create an auth test matrix for my Express app.
say_en.note: Generates tests for various token scenarios.

say_en.text: Scan FastAPI routes and generate input validation tests.
say_en.note: Covers missing fields, wrong types, boundary values, etc.
